description: Targeted interactive grammar practice targeting high-frequency errors in IELTS Writing and Speaking.

items.sentence_with_error: The rapid growth of suburban housing developments have placed immense pressure on local public transportation systems.
items.correct_sentence: The rapid growth of suburban housing developments has placed immense pressure on local public transportation systems.
items.explanation: The head noun of the subject noun phrase is 'growth' (singular), not 'developments' (plural). Therefore, the singular verb 'has placed' must be used.
options: growth of suburban housing developments have placed
growth of suburban housing developments has placed
growth of suburban housing developments were placing
growth of suburban housing developments having placed

items.sentence_with_error: Neither the increase in international tariffs nor the fluctuations in currency exchange rates affects small businesses equally.
items.correct_sentence: Neither the increase in international tariffs nor the fluctuations in currency exchange rates affect small businesses equally.
items.explanation: When using 'neither... nor', the verb agrees with the closer subject noun phrase. Since 'fluctuations' is plural, the plural verb form 'affect' is required.
options: nor the fluctuations in currency exchange rates affects
nor the fluctuations in currency exchange rates affect
nor the fluctuations in currency exchange rates is affecting
nor the fluctuations in currency exchange rates has affected

items.sentence_with_error: Government should allocate more funding towards renewable energy sources to protect environment.
items.correct_sentence: The government should allocate more funding towards renewable energy sources to protect the environment.
items.explanation: Definite articles 'the' are required before singular countable nouns referring to specific administrative bodies ('the government') and unique global entities ('the environment').
options: Government should allocate... to protect environment.
The government should allocate... to protect the environment.
A government should allocate... to protect a environment.
Governments should allocate... to protect an environment.

items.sentence_with_error: Excessive urbanization poses serious threat to biodiversity in developing nations.
items.correct_sentence: Excessive urbanization poses a serious threat to biodiversity in developing nations.
items.explanation: 'Threat' in this context is a singular countable noun and requires the indefinite article 'a' before the modifying adjective 'serious'.
options: poses serious threat to
poses a serious threat to
poses the serious threat to
poses an serious threat to

items.sentence_with_error: If governments implemented stricter recycling regulations, landfill waste decreased significantly.
items.correct_sentence: If governments implemented stricter recycling regulations, landfill waste would decrease significantly.
items.explanation: In Second Conditional sentences (hypothetical present/future), the structure is 'If + Past Simple, Subject + would + Base Verb'.
options: landfill waste decreased significantly.
landfill waste would decrease significantly.
landfill waste will decrease significantly.
landfill waste had decreased significantly.

items.sentence_with_error: If public transit authorities had modernized high-speed rail lines earlier, commute times would be reduced decades ago.
items.correct_sentence: If public transit authorities had modernized high-speed rail lines earlier, commute times would have been reduced decades ago.
items.explanation: In Third Conditional sentences (unreal past action and result), the main clause requires 'would have been + Past Participle'.
options: commute times would be reduced decades ago.
commute times would have been reduced decades ago.
commute times will have been reduced decades ago.
commute times had been reduced decades ago.

items.sentence_with_error: A dramatic rise in plastic waste reported by marine biologists during the last global summit.
items.correct_sentence: A dramatic rise in plastic waste was reported by marine biologists during the last global summit.
items.explanation: Passive voice requires a auxiliary verb 'be' matching the tense and singular subject: 'was reported'. Without 'was', the sentence lacks a finite verb.
options: plastic waste reported by marine biologists
plastic waste was reported by marine biologists
plastic waste reporting by marine biologists
plastic waste has reported by marine biologists

items.sentence_with_error: Substantial financial resources must dedicate to upgrading national healthcare facilities.
items.correct_sentence: Substantial financial resources must be dedicated to upgrading national healthcare facilities.
items.explanation: Modal passive structure requires 'modal verb + be + Past Participle': 'must be dedicated'.
options: must dedicate to upgrading
must be dedicated to upgrading
must have dedicated to upgrading
must dedicating to upgrading

items.sentence_with_error: Although automation increases industrial productivity, but it frequently leads to job displacement in traditional manufacturing.
items.correct_sentence: Although automation increases industrial productivity, it frequently leads to job displacement in traditional manufacturing.
items.explanation: Do not use both a subordinating conjunction ('Although') and a coordinating conjunction ('but') to connect the same two clauses.
options: Although automation increases industrial productivity, but it frequently leads
Although automation increases industrial productivity, it frequently leads
Because automation increases industrial productivity, but it frequently leads
Despite automation increases industrial productivity, it frequently leads

items.sentence_with_error: Students who engage in extracurricular research projects, they develop stronger analytical problem-solving skills.
items.correct_sentence: Students who engage in extracurricular research projects develop stronger analytical problem-solving skills.
items.explanation: Avoid redundant subject pronouns ('they') immediately following a complex noun phrase modified by a relative clause ('Students who engage...').
options: research projects, they develop stronger
research projects develop stronger
research projects which they develop stronger
research projects having developed stronger
